data.name: Munawarah
data.gender_notes: Munawarah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Munawarah is derived from the Arabic root ‘nawr’, which means ‘to adorn’ or ‘to be adorned’. In Islamic context, Munawarah refers to a woman who is beautifully adorned by Allah's blessings. The name Munawarah carries the meaning “The one who is adorned” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Munawarah usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who is adorned and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Munawarah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The one who is adorned.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Munawarah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
